title: Primary Chat · bind deterministic state compiler to CURRENT owners
mission: Implementá el contrato CANARY de estado/inteligencia/comunicación sobre owners runtime CURRENT ya existentes y alimentá Primary Chat sin crear segunda autoridad de estado o telemetry.
definition_of_done: El state compiler lee owners CURRENT exactos para liveness, frontier/recovery, capacity, returns, human durable intent y projection age.
Estados simples se renderizan template-first sin inferencia: REFILL_N, no-action, stale projection, human decision, buffer low, campaign complete.
Human idle usa sólo last_human_action_at durable; worker signals no resetean ese reloj.
Métricas temporales sólo se calculan cuando ambos timestamps existen; faltantes quedan UNKNOWN/null.
Harness runtime/source cubre >1h human return, active workers, 0 workers with frontier, buffer low, stale projection, claim transport degraded, human decision boundary y campaign complete.
No raw/private audio/transcript se publica; voice/TTS queda derivado y no autoritativo.
truth_boundary: Derived projection only; Current, liveness, scheduling, acceptance and telemetry authority remain with existing owners.
